newsitem.title: USA: Oshman's Sporting Goods names new president.
newsitem.headline: Oshman's Sporting Goods names new president.

text.p: Alvin Lubetkin, who has been chief executive of Oshman's Sporting Goods Inc since 1969, was appointed president of the company, Oshman's said Thursday.
Lubetkin replaces William Anderson, who resigned in July as president and chief operating officer.
In his new post, Lubetkin will assume all of the duties of the chief operating officer and will continue in his capacity as chief executive, the company said.
Oshman's operates 129 sporting goods stores in 18 states.
